state.rfi_text: RFI from Halvorsen Mechanical (halvorsenmech.example) to the design team, Cedar Ridge Clinic project. The mechanical sheet routes the main supply duct below the second-floor beam line along the north corridor, while the structural framing plan shows a transfer beam occupying that same space; the two sheets cannot both be built as drawn. This duct run has not started. To keep the duct in the corridor without lowering the ceiling, we propose to furnish round spiral duct of equal free area in place of the specified rectangular galvanized duct, since the round section clears the beam flange. Please advise which sheet governs and confirm whether the round spiral duct is acceptable in lieu of the specified rectangular duct.

rationale: The text both states that two drawings disagree and asks which governs (document_conflict) and proposes a different duct product than specified with a request for acceptance (substitution_request); the contract's stated order puts substitution_request first when more than one applies.

state.log_entry: Cedar Ridge Clinic daily log, superintendent D. Okafor, Thursday. Wind gusts all afternoon stayed within the crane's posted limits, so steel picks continued and no weather time was lost. The rebar delivery for the east footings never arrived; the supplier's dispatcher confirmed the truck was sent to their other yard by mistake. The four ironworkers shifted to formwork on the west line and the east footing pour is held until the steel is on site. On site: six laborers, four ironworkers, two carpenters, one operator.

rationale: The entry attributes the held pour to a delivery that did not arrive, and it expressly states the wind lost no time, so weather is not a stated cause and the precedence order never reaches it; the crew was present and reassigned, so no labor cause is stated either.

state.reviewer_response: Storefront and entrance system submittal, returned by Marrow & Tice Architects (marrowtice.example). The framing depth shown is less than the specified depth and the glazing scheduled is not the specified low-iron product, so as presented the package does not conform. Because the package also omits the required structural calculations and the engineer's stamp, this office has not performed a review of its content and is returning it unreviewed. Furnish a complete package addressing the above for review.

rationale: The response states the submittal was not reviewed and is being returned unreviewed, and the contract selects returned_without_review regardless of other remarks, so the non-conformance language (rejected) and the request for a new package (revise_and_resubmit) do not change the label.

state.change_request_text: Change Request 14, Brightwater Pharmacy fit-out, submitted by Kestrel Builders (kestrelbuilders.example). The pharmacy door and the adjacent partition were framed and sheathed exactly where the contract drawings place them, and our layout was checked by the surveyor before framing; this is not a contractor error and not rework of defective work. Owner's Bulletin 6 moved the door three feet north to suit the dispensing casework the owner selected after framing was complete. We request the cost of demolition, reframing, patching, and a new frame and hardware, and one week added to the schedule.

rationale: The narrative mentions rework but expressly denies that contractor error or defective work caused it, and it states no omission in the documents and no site condition; the only basis it states is the owner's bulletin and selection, so owner_directed applies and the contractor_caused precedence is not triggered.

state.observation_text: Observation card by safety coordinator R. Lindqvist, Cedar Ridge Clinic, east yard rebar station, mid-morning. Angle grinder in use with the wheel guard removed and the side handle missing. The operator was cutting reinforcing bar with sparks directed toward his face and neck; he is wearing safety glasses but no face shield. He continued cutting while I wrote this card and had three more bundles staged to cut. The cut-off wheel is the correct type for the tool and the extension cord is undamaged.
stop_work_conditions: Any person in an excavation deeper than five feet that has no shoring, shielding, or sloping in place.
Work at a leading edge or open side above six feet without a guardrail, personal fall arrest, or safety net.
Entry into a permit-required confined space without a completed permit and an attendant posted.
A crane pick with any part of the load or boom inside the utility clearance zone.

rationale: A missing guard and missing face shield are the contract's own examples of hazard_to_correct and appear nowhere on the supplied list, but the observation states the operator is currently exposed to the hazard described while work continues, which the contract makes a stop_work_condition and ranks first.

state.schedule_note: Week 31 schedule narrative, Brightwater Pharmacy, prepared by the Kestrel Builders scheduler. Exterior masonry started eleven working days late because the veneer brick arrived after the scaffold was already up. The masonry activity carries enough float that the substantial completion date is unchanged and the critical path still runs through the elevator, not the envelope. The contract milestone for building dry-in, however, now forecasts nine working days later than its baseline date, and the owner's early server-room move-in, which depends on dry-in, will move by the same amount. No time extension is requested at this time.

rationale: The note says float absorbs the masonry delay and that completion and the critical path are unchanged, which reads like absorbed_by_float, but it also states that a contract milestone moves, and the contract selects milestone_or_completion_moves whenever any milestone moves even if other float remains.

state.document_description: Title: Operation and Maintenance Manual, Rooftop Air Handling Units, Volume 2 of 3, submitted by Halvorsen Mechanical (halvorsenmech.example). Opening text: This volume contains the manufacturer's start-up, operating, and quarterly service instructions and the replacement parts list for the four rooftop units. The first tab reproduces the manufacturer's five-year compressor warranty, under which defective compressors will be replaced at no charge for five years from start-up. The second tab contains the installing contractor's marked-up duct shop drawings showing the final unit locations, which differ from the design drawings at the third unit.

rationale: The document contains three types (service instructions, a warranty, and as-built markups), and the contract says that when more than one type is present the type the title states is selected; the warranty-first precedence order applies only when the title states none.
